description: This file provides a partial implementation of the mbstring extension in PHP, based on iconv, focused on UTF-8 encoding and string manipulation functions. It defines a class 'Mbstring' with numerous static methods handling encoding conversions, string case transformations, length calculations, and other multibyte string operations.

classes.name: Mbstring
classes.description: A class providing a PHP implementation of multibyte string functions similar to the mbstring extension, handling encoding conversions, string case transformations, length measurements, and other string manipulations focused on UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: mb_convert_encoding
methods.description: Converts string or array of strings from one encoding to another using iconv.

methods.name: mb_detect_encoding
methods.description: Detects the encoding of a string based on a list of possible encodings.

methods.name: mb_strlen
methods.description: Returns the length of a string in characters, considering multibyte encodings.

methods.name: mb_substr
methods.description: Extracts a substring from a string considering multibyte encoding.

methods.name: mb_strpos
methods.description: Finds position of first occurrence of a substring within another string.

methods.name: mb_strtolower
methods.description: Converts a string to lowercase considering multibyte encodings.

methods.name: mb_strtoupper
methods.description: Converts a string to uppercase considering multibyte encodings.

methods.name: mb_internal_encoding
methods.description: Gets or sets the internal character encoding.

methods.name: mb_get_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about the current multibyte string configuration.

methods.name: mb_list_encodings
methods.description: Returns a list of supported encodings.

methods.name: mb_check_encoding
methods.description: Checks if the string is valid in the given encoding.

methods.name: mb_encode_numericentity
methods.description: Encodes characters to HTML numeric entities based on a codepoint range map.

methods.name: mb_decode_numericentity
methods.description: Decodes HTML numeric entities to characters based on a codepoint range map.

methods.name: mb_ucfirst
methods.description: Converts the first character of a string to uppercase.

methods.name: mb_lcfirst
methods.description: Converts the first character of a string to lowercase.

methods.name: mb_substr_count
methods.description: Counts the occurrences of a substring within a string.

methods.name: mb_strrpos
methods.description: Finds position of last occurrence of a substring within a string.

methods.name: mb_strrchr
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a character in a string.

methods.name: mb_stristr
methods.description: Finds first occurrence of a string within another, case-insensitive.

methods.name: mb_strripos
methods.description: Finds position of last occurrence of a substring, case-insensitive.

methods.name: mb_strwidth
methods.description: Returns the display width of a string.

methods.name: mb_output_handler
methods.description: A callback for converting character encoding in output buffer (identity function).

methods.name: mb_chr
methods.description: Returns a Unicode character for a given code point.

methods.name: mb_ord
methods.description: Returns the Unicode code point of the first character in a string.

methods.name: mb_str_pad
methods.description: Pads a string to a certain length with a given pad string, considering multibyte encodings.

methods.name: mb_trim
methods.description: Removes whitespace or specified characters from both ends of a string.

methods.name: mb_ltrim
methods.description: Removes whitespace or specified characters from the beginning of a string.

methods.name: mb_rtrim
methods.description: Removes whitespace or specified characters from the end of a string.
